requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD is the conjunction of listed support inquiries for X kind
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD(X) is true exactly when IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(X), IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(X), IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(FLAG, X) for valid FLAG, IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(FLAG) for valid FLAG, IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(X), IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(X), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(ROUND_VALUE, X) for valid ROUND_VALUE, IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(X), and IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(X) are all true, and false otherwise.

pending.ieee-support-standard-kind-conjunction: Evaluate IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD(x), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(x), IEEE_SUPPORT_DIVIDE(x), every IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,x) for the fixture's valid IEEE_FLAG_TYPE constants, every IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(flag), IEEE_SUPPORT_INF(x), IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(x), every IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING(mode,x) for the fixture's valid IEEE_ROUND_TYPE constants, IEEE_SUPPORT_SQRT(x), and IEEE_SUPPORT_SUBNORMAL(x); assert standard equals the logical conjunction, with each logical target initialized to the opposite sentinel. Mutation drops one conjunct.
pending.ieee-support-standard-true-implies-liste: From the same evaluated values, true branch for IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD(x) asserts every listed inquiry result is true; false branch records no missing-support attribution beyond the conjunction comparison. Mutation inverts one listed true value.

requirements.title: IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD without X reports all-real standard support
requirements.definition: IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD() is true exactly when IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD(X) is true for all real X, and false otherwise.

pending.ieee-support-standard-no-x-all-real-rela: Generate scalar representatives for every available real kind from ISO_FORTRAN_ENV REAL_KINDS, statically instantiating each kind as REAL(0.0,kind); assert IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD() .EQV. ALL of the instantiated IEEE_SUPPORT_STANDARD(REAL(0.0,kind)) results. This checks both directions: no-X true entails every X-form true, and all X-forms true entails no-X true. Mutation drops one kind-specific conjunct.
